description: Wunderlich reinforcement bar for the original engine protection bar • The rear, free end of the Adventure's original engine guard has no support against the frame and thus forms the Achilles heel of the engine guard. • This reinforcement bracket supports the engine protection bar, eliminates this weak point and optimizes the rigidity of the entire pipe assembly. • It prevents the engine guard from giving way and reduces the risk of damage to the clutch or alternator covers - reducing the risk of expensive con…. • Distributes the acting forces and moments to an additional attachment point on the right and left side.
source_description_html:
Wunderlich reinforcement bar for the original engine protection bar

  • The rear, free end of the Adventure's original engine guard has no support against the frame and thus forms the Achilles heel of the engine guard
  • This reinforcement bracket supports the engine protection bar, eliminates this weak point and optimizes the rigidity of the entire pipe assembly
  • It prevents the engine guard from giving way and reduces the risk of damage to the clutch or alternator covers - reducing the risk of expensive consequential damage
  • Distributes the acting forces and moments to an additional attachment point on the right and left side
  • The additional attachment points serve to reduce force and moment peaks
  • The shape of the reinforcement bar also contributes to the elastic reduction of occurring load peaks
  • Increases passive safety for machine and driver
  • Perfect fit
  • Integrated solution from a single source - thanks to the smart connecting element to the original protective bar
  • Easy and quick installation

Technical data

  • material
    • Stainless steel, precisely processed, glass bead blasted and electropolished
  • Dimensions
    • Pipe diameter 25 mm
  • Color
    • stainless steel colors

Your Wunderlich advantages

  • Small series. Handmade.
  • Wunderlich design. Functional and integrated.
  • Made by Wunderlich
  • Made in Germany
  • Wonderful 60/5
    • 60-day return policy - try it risk-free!
    • Plus 5 year warranty.

These reinforcement bars offer solid extra protection

The rear, free end of the Adventure's original engine guard has no support against the frame. This makes it the Achilles heel of the engine guard. In the event of a crash or a fall, it can give way because the forces and torque are not directly transmitted to the frame. This creates a risk of damage to the clutch or alternator covers.
This reinforcement bar, made of high-quality stainless steel, reliably eliminates this shortcoming. It connects the rear, free end of the engine guard to the frame. This means that acting forces are additionally transmitted via the bar to the appropriate point in the frame structure. This measure prevents the engine guard from giving way and reduces the risk of damage to the clutch or alternator covers. It also provides additional rigidity to the entire tube assembly, with its curved shape being designed to elastically absorb any peak loads that occur.
Precisely formed on CNC tube bending machines and cleanly welded, we manufacture the reinforcement from precision stainless steel tubing with a tube diameter of 25 mm. The surfaces are glass bead blasted and electropolished. This allows the reinforcement to blend seamlessly into the design of the original engine guard.

ULTIMATE tank guards are designed without compromise for protection during adventure riding

World-traveling adventure riders know this: There are those days when the motorcycle falls to the side more than once because the conditions are unimaginable in sophisticated and civilized Europe with its well-developed road network. Or because the physical exertion, heat, or cold simply leaves you with no strength or stamina to hold the bike. Beyond civilization, it is therefore all the more important to travel with reliable equipment that can "handle" the associated material stress and simply endure it without failing. After all, it can be vital to remain mobile, constantly on the move, and independent in order to minimize the potential for personal danger.
This Wunderlich ULTIMATE tank protection bar is specially designed for adventure riding and not only reliably protects the tank, but also the fairing, stem, and the vulnerable radiator unit. In conjunction with the original engine guard, it forms a sophisticated all-round protection concept for passive safety: In the event of a crash or a fall, the forces acting on the guard are optimally distributed across the guard structure to the resilient mounting points, thus reducing force and moment peaks. Visually, the guard integrates seamlessly into the design of the motorcycle and underscores its striking appearance. The tank guard is made from a composite of precision-machined stainless steel tubes. The tube segments are formed on CNC tube bending machines for each specific model and then neatly welded.
Our ULTIMATE guards focus on both protective effectiveness and product design. The tank guard protects and enhances your BMW, underscoring its adventure look in a high-quality manner.
